package.name: fm_imu_fusion
package.description: IMU-terrain fusion node for ExoMy rover autonomy. Fuses DINOv2 terrain classification with IMU slope measurement to override traversability decisions on inclined terrain. Addresses Exp 7b finding that DINOv2 texture-only classification misclassifies slopes visible only through IMU tilt (not camera appearance). Part of MSc thesis: Onboard Visual Foundation Models for Mars Terrain Perception and Rover Navigation.
